issues.where: night side of the planet, lower left of the disc (crops D and P in image-02/03)
issues.what: a faint orange diagonal streak and soft ghost blobs from the lens flare sit on top of the unlit hemisphere, so it reads like a smudge or a stray layer on the surface rather than a flare in the lens
issues.fix: lower the flare ghost and streak opacity where they cross the planet, or move them off the disc

issues.where: night side, centre left of the disc (crops H and P in image-06/07)
issues.what: the same diagonal flare streak and ghost circles show over the dark terrain and make the surface look dirty
issues.fix: suppress or reposition the flare ghosts so they do not land on the night side

issues.where: sun disc, right edge of frame (crops M and N in image-03)
issues.what: the solar disc is blown out to an almost flat cream fill with only faint mottling, and the corona filaments look brushed on and airbrushed instead of having a structure
issues.fix: pull back exposure on the sun so granulation and limb darkening show, and give the prominences sharper, more varied filament detail

issues.where: lit limb, crops C, E and G
issues.what: a soft orange halo runs outside the bright limb even though Mercury has no atmosphere, which looks like a glow layer added around the disc
issues.fix: narrow the rim bloom to a thin lens bloom or remove it

issues.where: lit terrain, crops A, F and G
issues.what: crater rims carry a crunchy, over-sharpened HDR look with bright edge highlights and blue-orange colour speckle, which feels processed rather than photographic
issues.fix: reduce local contrast and sharpening on the albedo/normal maps and tone down the colour saturation

issues.where: crop T, lower left of frame
issues.what: a bright flare blob is clipped at the crop edge and the faint bluish ghost disc next to it is a visible shape over the starfield
issues.fix: soften or remove the secondary flare ghosts

issues.where: lower-left starfield and dark night side of globe (image-14.png crop D, image-15.png crops N and O, image-16.png crop S)
issues.what: a blurry chromatic oval blob sits in the lower-left sky with a square ghost patch on the dark limb and muddy orange-brown diagonal streaks smeared across the unlit hemisphere
issues.fix: remove the synthetic lens-flare smudge and ghosted streak artifacts so the night side and surrounding starfield are clean

issues.where: sunlit upper and right limb (image-14.png crops C, F, H; image-15.png crops K, P)
issues.what: an orange atmospheric glow halo surrounds an airless cratered globe along a dead-smooth circular edge with no crater relief
issues.fix: remove the orange limb halo and render a crisp, un-glowing silhouette with subtle crater-rim profile relief against space

issues.where: bottom-right and bottom-left near foreground terrain (image-12.png crops T, W, X)
issues.what: the closest terrain goes soft, blurry, and smeared with stretched detail and bloomed white blotches at native crop scale
issues.fix: keep full-resolution displacement and crisp regolith micro-detail right to the bottom corners without lens-blur or texture stretching

issues.where: left-center mid-ground ray craters (image-10.png crop B, image-11.png crop K)
issues.what: the two bright ejecta ray systems look airbrushed and scratchy, with fibrous painted white strokes floating over the surface
issues.fix: replace the painted radial streaks with physically grounded, granular high-albedo regolith ejecta tied to the underlying topography

issues.where: across the dark regolith plains and crater rims (image-10.png crops D, E, F, G; image-11.png crops O, P; image-12.png crop U)
issues.what: dozens of isolated 1-3 pixel bright white and cyan/magenta sparkle specks sit on the dark terrain like render fireflies
issues.fix: clamp or filter sub-pixel specular fireflies and chromatic noise on the regolith surface

issues.where: upper-left dark limb against the Milky Way (image-14.png crop B)
issues.what: a dark masking halo borders the unlit limb where dense stars and dust abruptly thin out before reaching the planet edge
issues.fix: extend the starfield and Milky Way evenly right up to a clean geometric occultation edge with no dark falloff band

issues.where: horizon limb across the frame (image-10.png crops B, C, I; image-11.png crops L, M)
issues.what: a thin bright warm-white rim halo hugs a smooth circular horizon arc with almost no topographic silhouette
issues.fix: eliminate the bright edge halo/ringing along the limb and let sunlit crater rims break the horizon profile naturally

issues.where: Milky Way clouds on left and solar corona on upper right (image-14.png crops C, G; image-15.png crop K)
issues.what: Milky Way stars clump into soft blobs over blotchy brown patches, a horizontal green-grey band cuts left from the Sun, and sharp stars shine straight through the bright inner solar corona
issues.fix: sharpen star point-spread profiles, remove the horizontal flare band, and occlude or wash out faint background stars inside the blinding solar glare
